receipt.public_excerpt: So, do we have AGI? Not yet.

evidence_items.explanation: A leading AGI benchmark organisation said in December 2025 that AGI had not been reached. This supports 'AGI still hasn't come.'

receipt.public_excerpt: “If you define AGI (artificial general intelligence) as smarter than the smartest human, I think it’s probably next year, within two years,” Musk said

evidence_items.explanation: In April 2024 Musk promised AGI 'probably next year', meaning 2025. This is one of the earlier promises the claim refers to.

receipt.public_excerpt: Musk also predicted the artificial intelligence boom will have models that are "smarter than any human by the end of this year, and I would say no later than next year."

evidence_items.explanation: In January 2026 Musk again put smarter-than-any-human AI in the future, at the end of 2026. This implies it had not arrived, and it repeats his 2024 promise with a later date.

unresolved_gaps: AGI has no agreed definition, so 'not arrived' rests on expert judgment, not a formal test.
Only one industry leader's repeated promises are documented here; other CEOs' statements were not verified from primary text.
